text: Let's stop right here. This is manipulation. It shifts all the blame onto men, as if cheating is some kind of forced reaction instead of a personal choice. Problems in relationships happen. Sometimes big ones, sometimes small ones, but the adult way to handle them is either to talk and fix things or to end the relationship. What you don't do is cheat. Guys, you need to understand one thing. If a woman wants to cheat, she will find the reason. If her mindset is that cheating is normal, then she'll twist any excuse to justify it. He didn't give me attention, he didn't buy me flowers, whatever it is. And to be fair to the ladies here, the same can be applied to men. Cheating doesn't come from a lack of attention, dinners, or gifts. It comes from a lack of loyalty. If she cheated in the past, she'll most probably do it again. So men, don't fall into that trap. If your girl cheats and then says, well, you made me do it, that's gaslighting. Cheating is not about what you did or didn't do. It's about who she is. And once she shows you that, don't waste time making excuses for her.
